title: EloStonk
description: A fantasy game on Elo ratings: pick 5 players, make one captain, and score from how much better than expected they play each round.
intro: Pick 5 players and make one your captain. Each round, they score from how much better than expected they play, so an underdog's win counts more than a favourite's.
rules:
**Your squad.** Pick 5 players, aged 18 or over. One is your captain, whose points count twice. At most 2 can be from the same club, and the squad needs at least one man and one woman. Change your squad as often as you like until the round locks; after that it carries over to the next round until you change it.

**Rounds.** A round runs from Friday to Thursday and locks at 14:00 on its Friday (Norwegian time): the squad you have then plays the whole round, that Friday's matches included. So a weekend's tournaments and the team matches the week after belong to the same round.

**Points.** Every match one of your players plays in the round scores 100 × (the result − their chance of winning it, from Elodrop's ratings):
- a win at a 20 % chance: +80
- a win at a 90 % chance: +10
- a loss at a 90 % chance: −90

So favourites gain less than underdogs who win, and the same scale counts at every level. Losses count too, so a stonk can fall. More matches mean more chances both ways.

**When points come.** Points come in with the results, the night after each match day; late results can still change a round for 3 weeks, so recent rounds are marked provisional.

**Leagues.** Make a league and invite others with its link or 4-character code, to have a table of your own beside everyone's. A public league is listed for anyone to join.

EloStonk is free, with no stake and no prizes.
